caption: The drawing consists of a symmetrical, square composition filled with floral motifs resembling a cross-stitch or embroidery pattern. The central area features four large red flowers with multiple petals, each set at a 90-degree angle from one another, creating a mirrored effect around a vertical and horizontal axis. Surrounding these central flowers are various leaves and smaller flower shapes in shades of blue and red, with blue elements primarily positioned towards the corners and edges. The background is a pale pinkish color, with faint vertical white lines running throughout, giving the appearance of textile texture. The entire composition is bordered by a thin, double-lined red frame, and the overall drawing is centered on a larger off-white plain background. There are no additional objects or figures present, and the image contains only floral and leaf patterns in shades of mainly red and blue. A small signature is located in the lower right corner within the pink-bordered area.
title: Coverlet (Section)
